purpose: Final focused validation before paper writing; fixed before new outcome evaluation
geant_source_rule: Reject empty native demand sections in replay, lookback and the complete following day (conservative coverage of the two-bin label tail), rather than replace dates after outcomes
training: Original train and validation splits, transforms and architecture; original 40-epoch/8-patience settings; train GNN and matched GRU independently for all three seeds; no final-test access
capacity_contract: 10/20/40 Mbps per direction are predeclared simulation assumptions, not measured historical capacities or guaranteed light/moderate/heavy operating regimes. Same trace, candidates, allocator and transforms for every method in each condition.
seed_stability: At reference capacity only, repeat service-first and carbon multipath for GNN and GRU at seeds 7,42,123; do not select a winning seed
no_margin_controls: At reference capacity, run service-first GNN and carbon multipath GNN at seed42 with zero margin; isolate forecast replacement from margin removal
perfect_contract: Same planner/candidate paths/capacity/current carbon; replace forecast with actual next three demand matrices and set margin zero. Explicit future-aware offline diagnostic, not deployable and not a guaranteed bound on realized score/service.
workload_generation: Generate bursts through the two-label tail beyond each replay day so perfect-demand diagnostics have realized future labels
forecast_evaluation: All replay-bin starts on the seven declared days, labels extend two bins past the last day; normal source-scaled traffic, original training-only high-load threshold
statistics: Keep seeds separate; average within day before descriptive bootstrap, do not count model seeds as additional independent traffic days
interpretation: Locally frozen, not externally preregistered. Old archives already downloaded. Seven adjacent days per network and three seeds limit generalization. Carbon remains an attribution proxy; preserve all outcomes.
